SK Corporate Income Tax Return (DPPO)

The Slovak corporate income tax return — every official form edition since 2013, the accounting result from the books, the tax computation with the rate and minimum tax of the year, and an XML file checked against the Financial Administration's schema.

Version19.0.1.6.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cssk_income_tax_base, l10n_sk, l10n_sk_base
Extended byl10n_sk_dppo_annexes, l10n_sk_dppo_fs

What it is for

Every Slovak company files the daňové priznanie k dani z príjmov právnických osôb (DPPO) once a year. This module supplies that form to the income tax return screen of l10n_cssk_income_tax_base, whose guide describes the common workflow — creating a return, computing it, overriding rows, exporting, marking it filed and posting the tax. This page covers what is Slovak:

The published MF/014309/2026-721 edition additionally offers an unsigned official PDF download for the native body, Tables A/B and entered identity and declarations. See the paper output for its current scope.

  • the rows of each official form edition (vzor) from 2013 to 2025, with the Financial Administration's schema (XSD) for each;
  • r100, the accounting result before tax, computed from the books;
  • the tax computation from r100 to the tax payable, with the rate and the minimum tax of the year, on the editions where the module computes it;
  • the rows of a supplementary return (dodatočné priznanie);
  • with l10n_sk_fs installed, a check that r100 agrees with the financial statements (see below).

The tax adjustments themselves — which expenses are not deductible, which income is exempt, the loss carried forward — are the accountant's entries.

Legal background

References are to the Income Tax Act. Statutory terms are given in Slovak, as on the form.

  • Starting point. A taxpayer keeping double-entry books starts from the výsledok hospodárenia — § 17 ods. 1 písm. b). That is row r100.
  • Rate. For a legal entity § 15 písm. b) bod 1 taxes the base reduced by the tax loss at 10 % if its taxable income (zdaniteľné príjmy (výnosy)) for the period does not exceed 100 000 €, 24 % if it exceeds 5 000 000 €, and 21 % otherwise. Under § 52zzzb ods. 4 these rates apply first to a tax period beginning on or after 1 January 2025. For 2024 the wording then in force set 15 % up to 60 000 € and 21 % above.
  • Minimum tax. § 46b ods. 2 sets a minimálna daň by taxable income: 340 € up to 50 000 €, 960 € up to 250 000 €, 1 920 € up to 500 000 € and 3 840 € above. It is halved for an employer of enough disabled employees (ods. 3), charged as 1/12 per month for a period shorter than twelve months (ods. 6), and not charged in the cases of ods. 7, such as the first period of a new company. A minimum tax paid above the computed tax can be credited in the next three periods (ods. 5). For tax periods beginning on or after 1 January 2026 the wording in force adds a fifth band of 11 520 € above 5 000 000 € (§ 52zzzj ods. 5).
  • The earlier daňová licencia. Until 2017, § 46b set a daňová licencia of 480 €, 960 € or 2 880 € by VAT status and turnover. Under § 52zk it applied for the last time to a period ending on 31 December 2017, or to a fiscal year (hospodársky rok) ending in 2018.
  • Tax loss. A tax loss may be deducted over at most five consecutive following periods, up to 50 % of the base, or in full for a mikrodaňovník — § 30 ods. 1. Row r410.
  • Small amounts. Tax payable computed in the return is not paid if it does not exceed 5 € — § 46.
  • Deadline. The return is filed, and the tax paid, within three calendar months after the end of the period — § 49 ods. 2; a notice to the tax office can extend it under § 49 ods. 3.

Setting it up

There are no settings. Before the first return, check the company record (Settings → Users & Companies → Companies), because the header of the XML is filled from it:

Company field Goes to
DIČ (from l10n_sk_base), or Tax ID without its "SK" if empty DIČ
Company ID IČO
Company name obchodné meno (first 75 characters)
Street / ZIP / City / Country sídlo — the house number is the number at the end of Street (Hlavná 1141/11); Street2 is used only when it holds nothing but a number
NACE code of the company's contact (partner_nace) SK NACE (0 when empty)
Právna forma of the company's contact (l10n_sk_trade_registry) právna forma

Optional modules that feed the return:

  • account_asset_tax (tax depreciation). Table B is then filled from the asset tax register, and rows r150 (accounting depreciation above tax depreciation, added back) and r250 (tax depreciation above accounting depreciation, deducted) follow from it — see Tables A and B. Without it Table B stays empty unless you enter it.
  • l10n_sk_vat_registration. The daňová licencia depended on whether the company was a VAT payer on the last day of the period. With this module the registration date decides, or the registration category when no date is set; without it, or when neither is filled in, any company with a Tax ID counts as a VAT payer.

Form editions

When you create a return, choose the Version for the period. The list offers every edition whose validity overlaps the period, so a fiscal year (hospodársky rok) spanning two years offers two — choose the one the Financial Administration prescribes for that period. A 2026 period whose filing deadline falls on or before 31 December 2026 is offered DPPO 2025 (see Which form: the filing deadline). What the module computes depends on the edition:

Version Periods Computed by the module
DPPO 2013, DPPO 2014 2013; 2014 r100 and Tables A/B (r130, r150, r250) only
DPPO 2015 2015–2016 tax computation, rate 22 %, daňová licencia
DPPO 2017, 2018, 2019 one year each tax computation, rate 21 %, daňová licencia where § 52zk still applies it (see below)
DPPO 2020, 2021, 2022 2020; 2021; 2022–2023 r100 and Tables A/B (r130, r150, r250) only
DPPO 2024 2024 tax computation, 15 % / 21 %, minimum tax
DPPO 2025 2025, and later periods with a filing deadline on or before 31 Dec 2026 tax computation, 10 % / 21 % / 24 %, minimum tax

On the editions marked "r100 only" you enter every other row yourself, including the tax.

On the 2018 and 2019 editions r810 is 0 unless the period is a fiscal year (hospodársky rok) ending in 2018: § 52zk abolished the daňová licencia for every later period. The rows stay on those forms because a licencia paid for 2015–2017 can still be credited under § 46b ods. 5; enter that credit yourself.

Which form: the filing deadline

The form follows the filing deadline, not the period. Oznámenie MF/014310/2026-721 keeps the 2025 form (MF/012187/2025-721, DPPO 2025 here) for taxpayers "ktorým posledný deň lehoty na podanie daňového priznania uplynul najneskôr 31. decembra 2026", and prescribes the new form MF/014309/2026-721 when that day falls later. The ordinary deadline is three calendar months after the period ends (§ 49 ods. 2):

Period Deadline Form
1 Jan – 31 Dec 2025 31 Mar 2026 DPPO 2025
1 Jul 2025 – 30 Jun 2026 30 Sep 2026 DPPO 2025
1 Jan – 30 Sep 2026 (liquidation, a change of fiscal year) 31 Dec 2026 DPPO 2025
1 Jan – 31 Dec 2026 31 Mar 2027 2026 form (MF/014309/2026-721)

An extension under § 49 ods. 3 extends the deadline itself, and the oznámenie speaks of the last day of the deadline without excluding an extended one, so the module reads an extension as moving the form too. Enter the extended deadline in Applicable legal filing deadline; leave it empty for the ordinary deadline. A period ending on 30 September 2026 extended to 31 March 2027 therefore needs the 2026 form. The day you actually file changes nothing.

Every edition that overlaps the period stays offered while the deadline ends by 31 December 2026, so a fiscal year 1 July 2024 – 30 June 2025 is offered both DPPO 2024 and DPPO 2025, and you choose. Only DPPO 2025 is offered past its own validity, for the 2026 periods in the table. When the deadline ends later, only the 2026 form is offered, whatever the period. A return already on DPPO 2025 whose extended deadline is entered later refuses to export, and so does one on the 2026 form whose deadline ends earlier.

The published MF/014309/2026-721 form has a native calculation registry and a working paper copy; its electronic schema is a separate publication step (see the published-form section).

Minimum tax follows the period start. A period beginning on or after 1 January 2026 uses the 2026 minimum-tax bands on either form, so the 11 520 € band above 5 000 000 € applies (§ 52zzzj ods. 5) also on DPPO 2025, whose own bands stop at 3 840 €: r810 is 11 520 €, or 1/12 of it per month of a shorter period, when r560 is above 5 000 000 €. A period beginning in 2025 filed on the 2026 form keeps the 3 840 € ceiling.

The rate and the minimum-tax amounts are stored on each edition, not in the program. An edition whose rate is missing refuses to compute rather than guess one.

Computing the return

r100 — výsledok hospodárenia pred zdanením. The balance of classes 5 and 6 for the period, without income tax (591, 592, 595) and without the transfer of profit shares to partners (596). Only posted entries count.

Rows you enter (tick Override, type the amount, compute again):

  • the add-backs r110–r180 and the deductions r210–r290, except r130, r150 and r250, which come from Tables A and B;
  • r302–r308, r320, r330 (the other adjustments of the base) and r410, the tax loss deducted;
  • r501–r503, r610 (tax relief), r710 (foreign tax credit), r1040 (advance payments), r1060–r1071 (tax on special bases);
  • r560, taxable income. It defaults to the balance of class 6, which includes income that is not taxable; correct it when that differs, because both the rate and the minimum tax are chosen from it.

Rows the module computes on editions with the tax computation:

Row Computed as
r200 r110 + r130 + r140 + r150 + r170 + r180
r300 r210 + r220 + … + r290
r301 r100 + r200 − r300
r310 r301 + r302 + … + r306 − r307 + r308
r400 r310 − r320 − r330
r500 r400 − r410, never below 0
r510 r500 − r501 − r502 − r503
r550 the rate for r560
r600 r510 × r550, if r510 is positive
r700, r800 r600 − r610, then − r710
r810 the minimum tax (or daňová licencia) for r560, 1/12 per month for a shorter period
r820, r830 the positive difference between r810 and r800, on the row the edition uses for it
r900 r810, when the minimum tax exceeds the tax
r1050 the higher of r800 and r810
r1080 r1050 + r1060 + r1070 + r1071
r1100 / r1101 r1080 − r1040: tax to pay if above 5 €, or the overpayment as a negative amount

Amounts are rounded half up to cents. A row you override is never overwritten, so you can take over any of them — the halved minimum tax under § 46b ods. 3 or an exemption under ods. 7 is entered by overriding r810. The credit of minimum tax paid in earlier years (the r830 table and the rows after it up to r1000) is not computed.

The tax entry described in the framework guide books r1050; it is available on the 2024 and 2025 editions only.

Tables A and B

Part III of the form itemises two rows of the body: Table A (Položky, ktoré nie sú daňovými výdavkami) is the breakdown of r130, Table B (Odpisy hmotného majetku) the reconciliation behind r150 and r250. Each row of both tables is a line of the return, coded by table and row: a06 is row 6 of Table A, b02 row 2 of Table B.

Line Content (DPPO 2015 onwards) Computed as
a01 – a16 the items of Table A; a16 = other items entered
a17 úhrn a01 + … + a16
b01 accounting depreciation of tangible assets asset register, or entered
b02 tax depreciation before b04, without b05 asset register, or entered
b03 unclaimed part of a leased asset's depreciation (§ 19 ods. 3 písm. a)) entered
b04 depreciation not claimed because it was suspended (§ 22 ods. 9) asset register, or entered
b05 proportional depreciation in the year of sale (§ 22 ods. 12) asset register, or entered
b06 depreciation included in the tax base b02 − b03 − b04 + b05, never below 0
r130 a17
r150 b01 − b06 when positive
r250 b06 − b01 when positive

The 2013 and 2014 editions have a shorter Table A (a15 is the úhrn of a01 – a14) and a four-row Table B with the tax depreciation on b01 and the accounting depreciation on b02; there r150 = b02 − b01 and r250 = b01 − b02, when positive.

With account_asset_tax installed, b01, b02, b04 and b05 are read from the tax register for assets on a tangible asset account (anything but 01x). b04 is the charge a suspended year would have carried, b05 the whole months held in the year of sale for an asset marked for § 22 ods. 12. b03 is always yours. With b03 at 0, r150 and r250 are the company-wide difference between accounting and tax depreciation, as before.

Any of these lines can be overridden, the derived ones too. When a table carries a value, an overridden r130, r150, r250, a17 or b06 must agree with it: the export refuses a return where they differ, as the Financial Administration's form does. A return that types r150 straight onto the main row and leaves Table B empty is exported as before.

In the XML file a table row that nobody filled is left empty.

Supplementary return

Created with Amended / corrective from a submitted return (see the framework guide). Set the Statement Type to Dodatočné. On compute, the rows of the last known tax are filled from the previous return and the difference rows as this return minus the previous one:

Last known Difference From
r1120 r1130 r1050, tax or minimum tax
r1140 r1150 r400, tax loss
r1160 r1170 r1060, tax under § 17f
r1180 r1190 r1070, tax under § 51e
r1191 r1192 r1071, tax under § 51ea

A chain of supplementary returns works, since each one restates the full return.

The XML file

Export XML produces the dokument of the chosen edition and checks it against that edition's XSD as published by the Financial Administration. It contains the header — DIČ, IČO, name, registered office, period and the return type (riadne / opravné / dodatočné) — and every row of the body. It does not contain, and you must complete before filing:

  • the telephone and e-mail; the SK NACE code and the legal form when the company has none (see Setting it up);
  • the header declarations (e.g. mikrodaňovník, the halved or unpaid minimum tax, the credit of minimum tax), all written as "no";
  • the tables of the form other than A and B (C to K), the assignment of part of the tax (§ 50), the person signing the return, the number of attachments, the request for a refund of an overpayment.

The date of the declaration is the day of the export. The § 50 recipient, the oprávnená osoba and the stála prevádzkareň are left empty — earlier versions filled them with the company's own IČO, name and address.

The schema accepts the file with these left empty; the tax office will not accept the return without the parts that apply to you.

Comparison with the financial statements

With this module, l10n_sk_fs and the Slovak bundle l10n_sk_datadance installed, the bridge l10n_sk_dppo_fs installs itself and adds the button Porovnať s účtovnou závierkou to a computed return. It finds the financial statements (Účtovná závierka UZPODv14 (SK)) of the company covering the return's period — preferring one with exactly the same dates — and compares r100 with row 56 of the výkaz ziskov a strát (výsledok hospodárenia za účtovné obdobie pred zdanením). Both are the same accounting result, so they must agree to within 0.50 €; a difference means the two filings disagree, usually because of an overridden r100 or a different period.

The result is stored as a comparison on the return — the Comparisons button opens it — and is kept separately from any other comparison of the same return. If no financial statements exist for the period, the button says so and compares nothing.

Limitations

  • The 2026 form's XML adapter is pending. Its native calculation includes the 11 520 € minimum band; do not substitute the 2025 XML.
  • 2013, 2014 and 2020–2023 compute r100 and Tables A/B only; the tax is yours.
  • The meaning of rows 3 and 4 of the 2013/2014 Table B is not stated in their instructions; enter them from the form.
  • r560 defaults to the whole of class 6; on the 2015–2019 editions, which have no r560, the daňová licencia band is chosen from class 6 too.
  • The tables and declarations listed under The XML file are not produced.
  • Most body rows are labelled only with their number; read them against the official form and its instructions (poučenie).
  • The row definitions and the tax computation should be reviewed by your accountant before the first filing.

Published MF/014309/2026-721

The version list uses the applicable legal filing deadline, including an effective extension entered in Applicable legal filing deadline. Leave that field empty for the ordinary three-calendar-month deadline. A fiscal period July 2025–June 2026 ordinarily uses the earlier form; an effective extension to March 2027 requires the new one. December 2025–November 2026 already requires the new form without an extension. A late actual filing date changes neither rule. The minimum-tax top band still depends on when the period began.

The native return supports the published 2026 layout for ordinary periods starting in 2026 and later. The announcement applies where the last day of the filing deadline falls after 31 December 2026, subject to later replacements. This includes an ordinary 2027 first year filed in 2028; a name ending 26 is not a legal restriction to filing during 2027.

Row 310 is now the accountant's section 17k adjustment; the former subtotal moves 315. Sports 306 shifts the vehicle, practical-training and CFC inputs. The 11 520 € minimum above 5 million applies only to periods starting from 2026. Record any section 46b exemption or halving as a reviewed row 810 override; the override then flows into subsequent amounts and the tax provision.

The official paper form and instructions are published. The official XML adapter is a separate publication step: its schema was not in the reviewed catalog. Calculation is available; XML export gives an explicit explanation until the official electronic version is installed. It never emits 2025 XML for the new form. Source hashes and applicability are in data/FORM_PUBLICATION.json.

Official paper output

After computing the return, complete Official form inputs and use Official form PDF. Identity comes from the company and the selected native contact; the form additionally records the legal-form code, SK NACE, authorized person's entered names and relationship, declaration date and applicable declarations. A supplementary return requires its actual discovery date.

The download overlays the original 21-page MF/014309/2026-721 template, whose source and SHA256 are pinned in static/forms/SOURCES.json. The body and Tables A/B use the saved native return rows, including reviewed overrides. Changed ledger sources or calculation inputs require recomputation. Entered minimum-tax declarations must agree with row 810 and its period-sensitive amount. Values exceeding the actual printed boxes are rejected explicitly.

The paper adapter supports the core, A/B and entered Table I/D facts. Nonzero claims requiring other tables or annexes require their related entered inputs and adapter before printing; they are never silently omitted. The five original attached pages are retained, with the same DIČ and counted in the declaration. Table I continuation pages are counted additionally.

The PDF is an unsigned review/download snapshot. It leaves the tax return in its current state and does not create XML or mark it filed. An equal snapshot reuses its attachment; changing identity creates another snapshot and preserves the exact prior bytes. Electronic filing still needs the published XML adapter.

Table I entered transactions

On Official form inputs, enter each transaction or loan in Table I. Choose a native related contact and enter the published two-digit transaction code (01–37 for transactions, 01–05 for loans) and the three-digit official code of the counterparty's tax residence. Classification and significance remain reviewed accountant facts; the published instruction code list is the reference. Codes are checked for format/range and never silently truncated.

Transactions record a signed effect, aggregation and a permanent-establishment link under section 2(r). The effect is a disclosure, including effects in later periods; it is not a second posting or an amount to add to row 400. Loans record the highest principal during the period and the closing principal. The closing principal cannot exceed the highest principal. The separate below-threshold declaration covers only transactions not already aggregated into an entered row. These facts must agree with the front-page declaration.

The printed original has four transaction rows and five loan rows. More rows create clearly marked continuation copies of the original Table I pattern, with continuous ordinals and annex numbers. Each section permits at most 99 rows. Where more facts exist, the accountant must apply the published reporting priorities and retain the remaining transfer-pricing documentation; the programme does not silently discard any entered row. Inputs copy with a native amendment, are scoped to their company and cannot change on an exported/submitted return without the native reset workflow.

Table D prior tax losses

Enter the published column, original loss period and amount, prior deductions and the deduction claimed this period. Ordinary section 30 losses occupy columns 4–8 in chronological order. The current period's new loss stays in row 400; it first appears in Table D on a later return. An optional link to the native original return checks its company, period and negative row 400. Opening facts can also be entered from reviewed external records.

The following-tax-period number is a reviewed ordinal from 1 to 5, including short periods. It is not an elapsed-calendar-year calculation. An immediately following period must be number 1. The remaining balance is calculated from the original amount less prior/current deductions; after period 5 the unused balance expires and the future balance is zero. Special incentive columns 1–3 remain entered legal qualifications; a column 1 deduction also requires its explanation in Official form special records.

Apply reviewed Table D deduction transfers the sum to the existing native row 410 override and recomputes the existing tax return. It validates the newly recomputed base before committing. Ordinary losses have the published 50% limit; a currently qualifying micro-taxpayer can use the full base for eligible losses starting from 2021. Other qualifications remain reviewed facts; known contradictory micro declarations are rejected. The total cannot exceed the positive row 400 or the unconsumed original loss.

Changing Table D facts requires applying them again. Both the PDF and native tax provision reject a mismatch with row 410. Review other existing manual inputs before final output. Native provision/reversal remains the accounting workflow; no second tax ledger is created. All eight columns and the total are printed across the original pages 7–8. Special records wrap within the original page 15 field and reject over-capacity text instead of silently cutting it off.

This bounded adapter is still a review/download path: remaining nonzero special claims need their adapters before the full paper filing is complete. Later published form or legal changes require the normal publication refresh; this edition is not a guarantee of future portal acceptance.

Ordinary double-entry Tables F/L and advance tax

Table F reads operating/financial revenue and costs before income tax from the existing posted ledger, with the same account exclusions as native row 100. Revenue less costs must equal row 100. For reviewed imported accounting figures, enter the two source amounts and retain their evidence explicitly. This is form evidence; it does not create another accounting ledger.

Table L starts with F revenue. Enter every taxable-income adjustment with its signed amount, description, related three-digit return row and reviewed classification evidence. The linked net adjustment cannot exceed that return row's amount. Apply reviewed Table L revenue transfers its total to the existing row 560 override and recomputes the return. Changed facts must be applied again before PDF output or a provision using these facts. Zero-adjustment returns still print L1 and L99. All entered adjustments are printed. The original pattern has 26 slots numbered 2–21 and 23–28, skipping 22. It is preserved: marked continuation copies supply missing row 22, then 29–98, with annex numbers. More than 97 adjustments require reviewing the published form capacity; none are silently omitted.

For this published edition, row 1110 defaults to row 500 times the row 550 rate, less row 610, before the deductions in rows 501–503. Existing explicit accountant overrides remain available. Only a reviewed historic relief under sections 35/35a of Act 366/1999 uses the explicit legacy flag, retained evidence, a positive row 610 and zero row 1110; the printed field is then left blank. The flag does not infer legal eligibility.

Table K uses continuous whole-euro rectangles. Amounts and totals above four digits are right-aligned at the ordinary font size when they fit the actual rectangle. Cent digits retain their separate printed cells; an amount wider than the physical field is refused rather than clipped.

Tables E and K on the published paper form

The published MF/014309/2026-721 pattern applies when the last day of the legal filing deadline falls after 31 December 2026, until replaced. This includes the ordinary 2027 period filed in 2028 under the currently published notice. It is not a claim that future replacement forms already exist. The XML adapter for this pattern remains unavailable pending the authority's publication; historical XML must not be relabelled.

An accountant enters reviewed supporting facts on the existing tax return, then uses Apply reviewed Tables E/K credits. This atomically applies rows 710 and 920 and recomputes the existing tax spine. Table E calculates the official ordinary/hybrid ratios, limits and lower-of credit. Its country breakdown appears in section IX. Non-EUR source taxes require an evidenced section 31 conversion, printed as a separate annex. A lawful section 45(2) estimate requires a different foreign tax period; a paid source requires an actual payment date. Enter only tax permitted by the applicable treaty and supported by income and payment/estimate evidence.

Table K records a positive original minimum-tax difference, original minimum tax fully paid, prior usage, current usage and the reviewed first, second or third subsequent tax period. Count tax periods, including short periods, rather than calendar-year differences. In the first following period there can be no prior-period usage. Source periods cannot overlap. The total claim cannot exceed the native tax above the current minimum. Unused credits expire after the third subsequent period, with an explicit section IX explanation. K remains present when the current claim is zero and an evidenced carry-forward exists. The official four source-period rows are enforced; nothing is silently dropped.

The supporting facts do not determine treaty eligibility, establish that a payment was actually made, or replace a filed original return. The accountant retains those source documents, intervening-period evidence and reviews section 46b(8) expiry events, including liquidation, insolvency and legal succession. Existing declarations and ordinary manual review of such legal facts remain required. There is no second general ledger or tax register.

Edited inputs must be reapplied before PDF output or posting the native 591/341 provision. Inputs use the existing ordered parent locks, state guard, accountant ACL and company rule. Exported historical PDF attachments remain snapshots; recomputation/corrections create distinct outputs. All 21 original form pages remain in every PDF, with clearly marked continuations for country details or conversion evidence.

Primary sources and unmodified authority-asset hashes are recorded in static/forms/SOURCES.json. The annex implementation is covered by tests/test_dppo_table_ek.py.

The PDF is a working copy for review on the Ministry's published pattern. It retains the original VZOR and Príloha č. 2 marks. It is unsigned, cannot replace the required official electronic XML filing and proves no submission or acceptance. The header country is always printed in Slovak.

Historical Table K evidence is required even with no current credit, including a loss. Applying a zero current claim retains the evidence and remaining balance, leaves the current-claim column and rows 910–1000 empty, and preserves the current minimum tax. An explicitly entered zero current claim is distinct from evidence alone: it may fill those fields, but cannot waive a minimum that exceeds row 800. When the tax is not below the minimum, a lawful full credit still leaves row 1000 and row 1050 at zero. Row 1110 keeps its separate advance-tax calculation before deductions; it is not derived from this credit.

The form deadline and the minimum-tax period are separate: a January–September 2026 period filed on DPPOv25 uses the 2026 minimum-tax bands. Above EUR 5 million its nine-month minimum is EUR 8,640; a period starting in 2025 retains the old ceiling. An ordinary taxpayer with zero revenue or a loss still owes the modern minimum: EUR 255 for nine months in 2026 or EUR 340 for full-year 2025, unless an explicit reviewed exemption applies. Historical licence rules remain separate. Both native layouts and paper validation use the same calculation.
